0d4f9dba-f55f-4ff7-9f49-52311939504e.title: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru ~Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshi-tachi ga Ore wo Hottekurenai Ken~
0d4f9dba-f55f-4ff7-9f49-52311939504e.altTitle: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: My Hotshot Disciples are All Grown Up Now, and They Won't Leave Me Alone
0d4f9dba-f55f-4ff7-9f49-52311939504e.description:
Middle-aged Beryl Gardinant has only ever accomplished one thing: running a humble sword-fighting dojo in the quiet countryside. But when he's paid a visit by his former pupil, Allusia, he discovers that she has become an elite commander — and she's hardly the only ex-student who's a renowned warrior! Now forced by Allusia to become a special instructor to the strongest order of knights in the kingdom, can Beryl reach his full potential even though he's an old man?
___

6d6d9fda-5cd3-40ac-948b-776b1a1a0eb1.title: Suki na Ko ga Megane wo Wasureta
6d6d9fda-5cd3-40ac-948b-776b1a1a0eb1.altTitle: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
6d6d9fda-5cd3-40ac-948b-776b1a1a0eb1.description:
Komura is a middle school boy who is head-over-heels in love with his next-seat neighbor Mie, a girl with terrible eyesight who just can't get used to carrying her glasses, often leaving them at home, or accidentally breaking them. He opts to help her as much as he possibly can, and through those efforts, she begins getting acquainted with his kindness. Will she reciprocate?

---
A delightfully charming romantic comedy about a boy who only has eyes for the girl who always forgets her glasses!

With the new school year comes a new homeroom, new classmates, and a new desk for the timid Komura. But any trepidation he might've felt quickly dissipates when he catches sight of Mie, his new seat neighbor.

Apt to quietly blurt out the most random things, the quirky Mie wears thick glasses that accentuate her lovely eyes, making Komura’s heart skip a beat!

Unfortunately, Mie is pathologically forgetful and can never seem to remember to bring her glasses to class. It's not all bad, though! Her resulting squinty, mean-girl face sends Komura’s heart into overdrive too!

While Komura is keen to help out and share his textbooks with Mie, will his heart give out from the almost daily strain of being up close and personal with his crush?!

---
Alt. English Official: [Square Enix](https://squareenixmangaandbooks.square-enix-games.com/en-us/series/the-girl-i-like-forgot-her-glasses)

dfdd79ad-eae8-489f-8843-bfae7e08e74b.title: Yuusha Shoukan ni Makikomareta kedo, Isekai wa Heiwa deshita
dfdd79ad-eae8-489f-8843-bfae7e08e74b.altTitle: I Got Caught Up In a Hero Summons, but the Other World was at Peace!
dfdd79ad-eae8-489f-8843-bfae7e08e74b.description:
The other world was... at Peace.

A kind world where the three races, the Spirit World's Magical Races, the Celestial World's Divine Races, the Human World's Human Races, they are kind neighbours to each other, with everyone living a peaceful and fulfilling life. But although I wished to peacefully spend a year before my return, for some reason, the heavyweights of this world keeps gathering around me, and...

9478665e-412b-4e08-9844-5c07a732a71b.title: Eiyuu to Kenja no Tensei Kon
9478665e-412b-4e08-9844-5c07a732a71b.altTitle: Reincarnated — the Hero Marries the Sage: After Becoming Engaged to a Former Rival, We Became the Strongest Couple
9478665e-412b-4e08-9844-5c07a732a71b.description:
In a world ravaged by war and conflict, Hero Raid Freeden and Sage Eluria Caldwin clashed time and time again over fifty long years as the strongest soldiers of their respective nations. However, their long-standing rivalry came to an inevitable yet bitter end with Eluria's sudden death. A thousand years later, Raid finds he has been reincarnated—and so has Eluria! The world may now be at peace, but the two have an unsettled rivalry between them and the mystery of their reincarnation looms ominously over their heads. There's so much that needs to be done, so they decide to... get engaged and attend the Royal Institute of Magic together?!
___
* [Official English Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/the-hero-and-the-sage-reincarnated-and-engaged)

chapters.title: The Hero & The Sage steel their resolve

d3de0128-f60b-4fd2-acc6-fa4735659a34.title: Hyeonsil Quest
d3de0128-f60b-4fd2-acc6-fa4735659a34.description:
Ha Do-wan is a bullied gamer, whose bullies force him to grind to obtain in-game items for them. 

After one such bully demands that Dowan obtain an impossibly rare item for him or be beaten in front of the prettiest girl in school, Dowan games day and night for a week until he drops dead from exhaustion. 

However, as soon as he dies, he respawns back in his classroom one week before his death. Everything is the same as it was before, except now he has all the skills he’s acquired from the games he’s played in real life! 

Will Dowan be able to use his newfound abilities and gamified existence to defeat his bullies?

fd4d1e88-f32d-4c31-8ce7-cc8f58112554.title: Konya , Aether de Machiawase
fd4d1e88-f32d-4c31-8ce7-cc8f58112554.altTitle: Let’s Meet Up On Aether Online Tonight
fd4d1e88-f32d-4c31-8ce7-cc8f58112554.description: Hikage Itsuki has always been alone, and her one joy in life is Aether Online, an online video game. But on one day she was wondering about spending it with "someone", she met a new player in the game, Yoru. And the pleasant times she spends with Yoru will change her little by little.

ec94b8e4-b9a8-4f10-9fd6-0bb6e33377b8.title: Our Field of Dreams
ec94b8e4-b9a8-4f10-9fd6-0bb6e33377b8.description: A soccer loving boy Takasugi Kazuya dreams of playing soccer with his Japan League star father at the National Yoyogi Stadium. The story follows Kazuya's life as he travels to Argentina, plays for Yamaki, and goes to the 1998 World Cup in France.

5d61265a-c4bd-487e-9b5a-6e8f4df9394b.title: If This Maniac Is a Trial
5d61265a-c4bd-487e-9b5a-6e8f4df9394b.altTitle: If This Fool Is an Ordeal Too
5d61265a-c4bd-487e-9b5a-6e8f4df9394b.description:
Sylvere, Tasha’s notorious maniac alchemist.
When a prophecy declares that he will awaken as a hero, Yvor Hussman, a priest of the Grand Temple, is sent to take him to the capital.
Without a priest, a hero is bound to lose control. At least, that's what they claim in the name of preserving peace.
But… could this man really be nothing more than just a maniac?!
“If this maniac is a trial, then I shall accept it...!”
Will Sylvere and Yvors reach the capital safely?

5c21aab3-dba7-46fd-be36-6c860a22d950.title: Murimseobu
5c21aab3-dba7-46fd-be36-6c860a22d950.description: The tyranny of the Empire has lasted a thousand years, and true martial arts is but a thing of the past. However, there are still heroes in the most unlikely of places— amongst the motley band of soldiers and outlaws who left the old continent for the New World. One such vigilante, the lone wanderer Janggeon, has the hope of restoring martial arts to its former glory… but is that such an easy thing as it seems?

158bc0cc-e79e-4f13-a001-6d0abe9733ab.title: The House Without Time
158bc0cc-e79e-4f13-a001-6d0abe9733ab.description: An abused little girl with nothing to live for meets an old man with a nasty personality.

3ca5dc75-ae58-4162-a1c5-26d73110e338.title: Top Ranker ui Jakga Jimang Saenghwal Baekseo
3ca5dc75-ae58-4162-a1c5-26d73110e338.altTitle: The SSS-Ranker Who Wrote His Own Legend
3ca5dc75-ae58-4162-a1c5-26d73110e338.description: Seorang hunter legendaris melepaskan gelarnya demi menjadi penulis web novel, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa ceritanya kurang terasa nyata. Demi memperbaikinya, ia menyamar sebagai pemburu lemah peringkat-F dan bergabung dengan guild kecil yang tengah berjuang demi riset. Apa yang dimulai sebagai sekadar observasi berubah menjadi kekaguman yang tulus, mendorongnya untuk berkembang baik sebagai individu maupun sebagai penulis. Mampukah seorang mantan pejuang bak dewa sukses sebagai novelis biasa?

e0c9100e-287d-4417-8c17-b4e696254dc7.title: Kumichou Musume to Sewa-gakari
e0c9100e-287d-4417-8c17-b4e696254dc7.description: Kirishima Tooru is the right-hand man of the Sakuragi crime family. For him, the job is a perfect excuse to let his violent instincts run wild, earning him the nickname "the Demon of Sakuragi." It seems like nothing will stand in the way of his vicious nature. But then one day, he receives an assignment like never before from the boss—babysitting his daughter!
